module: Node "Enter Vehicle" (category `dynamic_instant`, depends on `gameplay_walk`). Makes the player enter a vehicle (`gameplay_walk.getInVehicle(veh)`) then restores the game camera (`commands.setGameCamera()`). Input pin: `vehId`. If `vehId` is not connected, the node takes the player vehicle (`getPlayerVehicle(0)`).
notes: Dynamic category: in `repeat` mode, `work` repeats the entry every frame; otherwise only `workOnce` acts.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

enterVehicle.desc: Finds the vehicle (`vehId` or player), calls `gameplay_walk.getInVehicle` and `commands.setGameCamera`.

work.desc: If `dynamicMode == 'repeat'`, repeats the entry into the vehicle every frame.

workOnce.desc: Makes the player enter the vehicle once.
